newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ wool prices improve at Christchurch sale.
newsitem.headline: NZ wool prices improve at Christchurch sale.

text.p: Wool prices significantly improved at a sale in Christchurch on Thursday, the market indicator rising 20 cents to 438 NZ cents per kg (clean), Wools of New Zealand said.

The 2,194 clean tonnes on offer comprised 38 percent crossbred wool, 23 percent second shear, 12 percent lamsbwool, seven percent halfbred fleece, five percent second shear bellies and pieces, four percent bulky skirtings, two percent crutchings and two percent merino fleece.
Twenty percent of the offer was passed in.
Compared with the last sale at Napier, crossbred fleece and second shear was up by 2-4 percent and cotts were up by 3-4 percent.
First and second lambs wool was generally unchanged, crutchings were up by 2-3 percent and bulky skirtings and second shear bellies and pieces were up by 2-3 percent.
Main interest came from Western Europe and China with support from Turkey, Nepal, Australia, India, Pakistan and local mills. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
